help_body:
1. Plan in the morning. Crew, then a building.
2. Standby returns the selected crew member.
3. A right-side building, then an empty tile.
4. Upgrades and shelter are morning choices.
5. Place the crew and press Work. That day finishes and the night results appear. Press Prepare to plan the next day.
6. Survival −2 daily. Water +1. Ren adds +1.
7. Plants harvest every 5 working days. Mio adds +3.
8. Research 10 strengthens the shield.
9. Research 20 grows harvests. Research is not spent.
10. On a flare, keep research or pause the lab for cover.
11. Shelter rests everyone. A built shield stays. Night motion is visual.

Survive 15 days and gather 30 research to win.
Negative survival or power, or zero health, ends the run.
Crew and power are required. Shelter pauses production.
New bases use 5 power/day for life support. Balance solar and lab crew (game balance, not NASA measurements). Old saves keep their original rules.
sources_body:
Warnings are inspired by NASA SDO’s observation
of an X8.7 flare on May 14, 2024, not live weather.

Survival combines water and food into one game resource.
Resource units, production and health effects are
game balance, not NASA measurements.
